title: Fitting a power law in log coordinates
description: You can connect a straight-line fit with the model's original parameters.

steps.description: You take logarithms of trials and observed before fitting a line. polyfit returns the slope and intercept in those transformed coordinates.

steps.question: How does the code recover alpha_hat from the fitted slope?
steps.answer: It negates the slope. The same assignment exponentiates the intercept to recover T1_hat.

steps.description: The supplied output reports alpha_hat as 0.346. You use the recovered parameters in T1_hat times trials raised to negative alpha_hat.
You label both axes as logarithmic and show observations beside the fitted power law. The recording supplies a parameter summary but no rendered plot.
